sources.findings: Three caruncles before dorsal fin, central largest; eight caudal rays, small pectoral. Family males: large eyes, upper snout denticular pair and two lower pairs; Cryptopsaras anterior lower pair larger. Documented ventrolateral/anterior opercular and other attachment positions; no universal single attachment site.
